outcome.technical: stamp-verification.py red now keeps each finished leg under a sha256 key (leg_inputs/leg_key: HEAD sha, argv, leg name, laid-over files by path+sha256 with None for absent, stubs, absent, inline overlay digests, dependency plan, helper code digest over stamp-verification.py+_proc_group.py bytes, interpreter version, environment digest) in <git common dir>/audit-red-legs (LEG_STORE_DIR), newest LEG_STORE_KEEP (a hit refreshes mtime), written only when the key re-read after the leg equals the key before and the leg finished (code, no problem); reuse_or_run replays code/text/copied. run_red routes every leg (baseline, task, task-held, task-support, second, fix) through a leg() closure over reuse_or_run; the throwaway is built lazily by ensure_tree() on the first miss, so an all-hit proof builds none. red_legs entries for a replayed leg: ran false, reused true, seconds 0.0, recordedSeconds, key, recordedAt, why 'reused, key K16, recorded at T' (drive-phase proof_legs_said already prints a not-run leg with its why). The store is not a worktree so leftover_throwaways (git worktree list) never sees it (lr12). Added 14 cases in 3 new STAGES blocks (sr-leg-store lr1-lr7, sr-leg-inputs lr8-lr9, sr-leg-reuse lr10-lr14). Existing case adjusted: jd1's rewrite anchor moved to the new leg() call site. tools/lints/_deps.py gained the OTHER_WRITERS row for _save_leg that pw1 demands (scope widened by the orchestrator); PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md section and changelog.d/P173.3.changed.md added. Evidence: sweep of tests/test_stamp_verification.py exit 0, 381 cases; with test__deps, test__output_lints, test__filed_returns, test_audit_lookup, test__affected_tests 6/6 files ok 1300 cases; ruff clean; vermin 3.8 ok; --register-citations 0; changelog-check exit 0; gate-parity exit 0. Own mutation (scratchpad mut2.py: laid-over digest field dropped from leg_inputs in an in-memory copy) turned lr8, lr9, lr13, lr14 red. Dependants: tests importing the module (test__claude_home, test__filed_returns, test__proc_group, test_audit_lookup, test_audit_task, test_stamp_verification) still correct - same payload, only added legs fields; tools/affected.py path mapping unchanged; PLUGIN-BUILD-GUIDE.md section extended; _filed_returns.py prose mention unaffected; drive-phase.py proof_legs_said still correct (reads ran/why). Caveats: the key cannot see linked dependency directory contents or a test reading a clock/network; env is keyed whole so a drive whose inherited environment varies between rounds will miss (hit rate in a real drive not measured here); an all-hit proof judges 'others' (module-name matching) from HEAD's files alone since no throwaway exists. Process note: two source edits (the run_red call-site rewrite and the atomic-write swap) were made with a python heredoc rather than the Edit tool, contrary to the instruction; content verified by the suite.
